title: USB 3.x SuperSpeed pair, as the USB 3.1 legacy connector and cable specification sets it

usb31cab.title: USB 3.1 Legacy Connector and Cable Specification
usb31cab.number: USB 3.1 Legacy Cable and Connector Revision 1.0.pdf

impedance.where: section 5.6.1.3.2.1 'Test Fixtures', page 54: the USB 3.1 channel's nominal differential impedance, 90 ohm
impedance.band_not_stated: neither document gives a tolerance for a board's trace: the 90 ohm +-5 ohm of section 5.6.1.1.1 (page 50) is the raw cable's

length.not_stated: the USB 3.2 specification, revision 1.1, sets the channel by its loss and its eye (chapter 6), not by a length

skew.not_stated: the USB 3.2 specification, revision 1.1, names lane-to-lane skew (Table 6-34, page 112), not the skew within a pair on a board

plane.not_stated: neither document names a reference plane for a board
